title: details view + compact view in Folder View
line: Folder View widgets on the desktop can now show their files as a compact list, like the panel popup does.
explanation: Folder View already has a list view, but main.qml only enabled it when the widget was in a panel, and the settings page only offered the View mode choice there. The viewMode default was 0 (List), which every existing desktop widget also has, so simply lifting the panel check would have turned all of them into lists. Lifting it also exposed two problems: list rows had no padding off the panel because the row-spacing SVG was only loaded in panels, and the widget's root size was bound to its preferred size, so any change of size hints (view mode, icon size) shrank the content inside its frame. The View mode setting is now shown for every Folder View widget; a new default of -1 means List in a panel and Grid elsewhere, so no existing widget changes, the row SVG follows the list mode, and the initial size is set once instead of being a live binding.

commits.message:
containments/desktop: offer list view in Folder View widgets on desktop

List view was only available in panel popups. The view mode is now
offered for every Folder View widget, List in a panel and Grid elsewhere
by default, and the content no longer shrinks when size hints change.

BUG: 354684
